enforcement_status.previous_state: AUD-READ03 / LNX-03 / CRIT-SUB-01: reader roles were read-only by BEHAVIOUR only; no technical isolation was accredited.
enforcement_status.resolution: A reproducible enforcement mechanism now exists in the repository (scripts/readonly_role_sandbox.sh) and is verified by scripts/verify_readonly_sandbox.sh and tests/test_readonly_role_sandbox.py (8 tests). Writes to the repository and to the real HOME fail with EROFS; DNS resolution is unavailable; the sandbox /tmp is ephemeral; no probe survives outside.
enforcement_status.residual_limitation: The harness itself does not place a subagent process inside the sandbox. Enforcement applies to the shell commands a reader role executes through the wrapper, which is where its filesystem access happens. The subagent's own tool calls outside that wrapper remain behaviourally, not technically, constrained. This distinction is preserved and NOT presented as full per-process isolation.
